description: Returns a link to ServerScan's signup page with the plan picked and the domain filled in, for the person to open, check and pay. Creates nothing and charges nothing. For a penetration test, of a network or of web applications, it returns the page to request a quote from.

domain.description: asv_scanning only: the domain or IPv4 address to scan, filled into the signup form. A URL is cut down to its host.

include_monitoring.description: asv_scanning only: add payment page monitoring to the scan plan.

product.description: What to buy. penetration_test tests a network by IP address; web_app_penetration_test tests web applications and their APIs while logged in.

term.description: Billing term. Defaults to one_year, the cheaper per quarter.

name: start_order

price.description: Price for the whole term, two decimals.

url.description: The signup or quote page for the person to open.

title: Get a ServerScan signup link
